details: Lokumers for the Space (Mission Architect) is an interactive web-based space mission design and orbital flight simulator. Players act as aerospace engineers tasked with planning, building, and flying spacecraft across 7 real destinations in our Solar System from Low Earth Orbit and the Moon to Mars, Mercury, Ceres, Jupiter, and Titan. During the design phase, players must balance four interconnected engineering constraints: Budget (M), Mass (kg), Power (W), and Data Downlink (Gb/day). Every choicefrom selecting the launch vehicle, bus, propulsion system (chemical, ion, Hall-effect, nuclear thermal, or plasma), and power source (solar panels vs. nuclear RTGs/fission reactors) to scientific instruments and ground station networks dynamically impacts the others. Once launched, the simulation runs real-time orbital mechanics and pauses during unexpected space crises (such as solar flares, software glitches, trajectory drifts, and budget overruns), requiring players to make critical decisions. It also features a 2D Rocket Workshop, where players assemble multi-stage rockets piece by piece and manually pilot them into stable orbit, plus Co-op (role-based) and Team Competition modes. Our goal is to bridge the gap between complex aerospace engineering concepts and accessible STEM education. By turning orbital mechanics, link budgets, and systems engineering into a hands-on, risk-free experience, the game teaches critical thinking, resource management, and problem-solving under pressure. After each mission, an automated Post-Mission Analysis grades the flight (0–100 points), diagnoses exact failure causes, and compares player decisions against optimal engineering choices so learners improve through iteration.
